描述_EN: the leaders of the liao dynasty belonged to the qidan, a nomadic people who originally settled outside the borders of china. it was produced in north china during the liao dynasty (907-1125 ad). the flask imitates a portable pouches, made of animal skins, used by the nomadic qidan. this ceramic flask is in the shape of a leather bag and is decorated with a twin fish design.
描述_ZN: 辽代的领导人属于契丹人，契丹人是一个游牧民族，最初定居在中国的边界之外。 它产生于中国北方的辽代（公元907-1125年）。 这个烧瓶模仿的是游牧民族契丹人使用的兽皮制成的便携袋。 这个陶瓷烧瓶是一个皮包的形状，上面有一个双鱼的图案。
